title: One canonical end-to-end morphology verification run
description:
Source: docs/tasks/tickets/CC-081-canonical-end-to-end-verification-fixture.md
Source key: CC-081
Source status: Backlog
Source priority: P2

## Summary

Test evidence is fragmented across focused runtime runs, broader runs with
baseline failures, initialization timeouts, and editor-only manual checks.
Before the morphology foundation is called stable, establish one canonical
verification command/run that proves the full chain for one canonical dino
fixture plus several adversarial fixtures.

## Scope

One run that proves:
```text
Definition -> Morphology -> SDF -> Mesh -> Skeleton -> Rig -> serialization
```
- One canonical dino fixture plus adversarial fixtures (mirrored, child-at-tip,
  limb chains, mesh-asset items, non-finite inputs).
- Deterministic topology + value assertions at the SDF/mesh boundary.
- Recorded command and expected pass set so new work has a single regression
  gate instead of a loose collection of runs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The canonical run is documented with its exact command/filter and expected
  pass count.
- The five documented pre-existing PlayMode failures are explicitly separated
  from regressions.
- A new contributor can run one command to see the whole chain green.

## Validation

The run itself is the validation: all chain stages pass on the dino + adversarial
fixtures.

## Findings

The 2026-08-24 delta audit (§13) flags that focused runs, baseline failures, and
timeouts make it hard to prove the foundation is stable. This ticket consolidates
that evidence into one gate.

## Blockers

None; can proceed in parallel with CC-056A migration.

## Next Step

Define the fixture set and the exact NUnit filter, add any missing chain-stage
asserts, and record the command in the README validation section.

comments.body:
Round 3 (final) BeastMaster evidence.

CHAIN-COVERAGE AUDIT: Current suite is GREEN — there is NO pre-existing 5-failure set to separate from regressions (the stale 2026-08-24 note is resolved). Full default Runtime PlayMode suite passes 538/538 at capture. Every chain stage was already covered by dedicated per-stage fixtures (JsonDnaSerializer* serialization; SdfProgramBuilder*/DensityGrid* SDF; MarchingCubesExtractor*/parity/winding/topology mesh; SkeletonInferrer* skeleton; CreatureRigTests rig; GeneratedCreatureTests generation multi-item + CC-091 parity). What was MISSING: one coherent cross-stage integration gate that drives the whole chain on one canonical dino + adversarial fixtures with deterministic topology/value assertions at the SDF/mesh boundary — the per-stage fixtures each use small synthetic inputs and never combine stages on a full dino. No [Category] existed anywhere.

CANONICAL GATE ADDED: new PlayMode fixture `Assets/Scripts/Tests/Runtime/CanonicalMorphologyChainTests.cs` (+ .meta), [Category("CanonicalMorphologyChain")], 6 deterministic tests on a canonical dino (even straight spine + mirrored Leg, Foot child-at-tip, mirrored Eye) + adversarial (mesh-asset item, non-finite input): determinism+watertight implicit surface; serialization round-trip chain parity; mirror-never-cascades; rig rest hierarchy from inferred skeleton; mesh-asset item rig-binding + serialization; non-finite rejected before chain.

VALIDATION (Unity 6000.5.9f1): dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj clean (0 warn/0 err). Unity PlayMode category CanonicalMorphologyChain: 6/6 passed. Unity default Runtime PlayMode suite: 538/538 passed (532 prior + 6 new), 0 failed. git diff --check clean. No commit/push (HEAD a40fdfa). README validation section updated with run command, fixture set, and expected pass count (6).

Changed files: README.md (doc); new CanonicalMorphologyChainTests.cs + .cs.meta. No production behavior change. No redundant duplicates of existing canonical tests (the gate is a new cross-stage integration, not a copy). Left InProgress for orchestrator review + commit.
